items.title: 8.3 Plane polarized light paida karna aur pakarna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.3 with Fig. 8.5 (PDF 176-177).

blocks.text: Aam incandescent bulb, aur suraj, ki nikalti light unpolarized hai, kyunke us ki (electrical) vibrations fiza mein be-tarteeb rukh mein hain (Fig. 8.5a).

Agar unpolarized light polaroid ki sheet (polarizer) par dali jaye to guzarti light plane polarized hogi. Agar polaroid ki doosri sheet is tarah rakhi jaye ke dono polaroids ke axes, jo un par khinchi seedhi lakeeron se dikhaye gaye hain, mutawazi hon (Fig. 8.5b), to light doosre polaroid se guzar jati hai. Agar doosre polaroid (analyzer) ko light ki beam ko ghoomne ka mehwar (axis) bana kar aahista ghumaya jaye to doosre polaroid se nikalti light dheemi se dheemi hoti jati hai aur jab axes ek doosre ke amudi hon to ghayab ho jati hai. Mazeed ghumane par light wapas aati hai aur jab axes phir mutawazi hon to sab se roshan hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Do qataarein. Har simt mein larazti unpolarized roshni polarizer se guzar kar aik plane mein larazti nikalti hai. (a) Analyzer ka axis polarizer ke mutawazi ho to roshni guzarti hai aur screen roshan hai. (b) Analyzer 90 degree ghuma dein to roshni nahi guzarti aur screen andheri, jo dikhata hai ke roshni ki lehrein transverse hain.
blocks.caption: Mutawazi (a) aur aar-paar (b) axes wale polarizer aur analyzer: roshni ki lehrein transverse hain (Figure 8.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Tajruba kya sabit karta hai
blocks.text: Yeh tajruba sabit karta hai ke light waves transverse waves hain. Agar light waves longitudinal hoteen to dono polaroids ek doosre ke amudi hone par bhi kabhi ghayab na hoteen.

blocks.caption: Analyzer ghumana
rows: mutawazi aur amudi ke darmiyan ghumaye
wapas aati hai, sab se roshan

blocks.text: Pani ki hamwar sath se mun'akis light sath ke mutawazi juzvi (partially) polarized hoti hai (Ponder Upon).

blocks.prompt: Jab I0 intensity ki unpolarized light polarizing sheet par pare to kitni intensity nahi guzarti (numerical 8.1)? Kya polarizer ko analyzer ke taur par istemal kiya ja sakta hai (constructed response 8.2)?
blocks.explanation: Polarizer vibrations ka sirf woh juz (component) guzarta hai jo us ke axis ke saath ho, jo unpolarized light ke liye aadhi intensity hai, to I0/2 guzarti hai aur I0/2 nahi guzarti. Haan: polarizer aur analyzer ek jaisi polaroid sheets hain, aur naam sirf un ki jagah par munhasir hai. Fig. 8.5 mein doosra polaroid analyzer ke taur par istemal hua hai, aur pani ya mez se mun'akis light ke saamne ghumai polaroid sheet ya polarized sunglasses analyzer ka kaam karti hain aur dikhati hain ke yeh light juzvi polarized hai.

items: Bulb ya suraj ki light unpolarized hai. Polarizer: plane polarized light banata hai. Analyzer: doosra polaroid; mutawazi axes light guzarte hain, ghumane se light dheemi, crossed axes rok dete hain, phir mutawazi par sab se roshan.
Is se sabit hota hai ke light transverse hai: longitudinal wave crossed polaroids ke darmiyan kabhi ghayab na hoti.
